courses.title: Assessment in Basic Schools
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 234 quizzes and examinations (2020/21–2021): test, measurement and evaluation, scales of measurement, assessment for, as and of learning, Bloom's and Krathwohl's taxonomies, validity, reliability and the standard error of measurement, and test construction.

courses.title: Curriculum Studies in English
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 239 Curriculum Studies in English (2021): the English language curriculum, approaches to teaching language skills, and lesson planning.

courses.title: Curriculum Studies in ICT
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 242 Curriculum Studies in ICT (2021): curriculum concepts and types (overt, hidden, null), Taba's and Wheeler's models, the ICT curriculum and its implementation.

courses.title: Curriculum Studies in Mathematics
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 243 Curriculum Studies in Mathematics (2021 quiz, mid-semester and end-of-semester): the mathematics curriculum, curriculum development and evaluation, and teaching approaches.

courses.title: Curriculum Studies in Science
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 247 Curriculum Studies in Science (2021): the science curriculum, curriculum models and design, science process skills and implementation.

courses.title: Curriculum Studies in Social Studies
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 248 Curriculum Studies in Social Studies (2021): curriculum concepts, the Saber-Tooth Curriculum, philosophies of education and the social studies curriculum.

courses.title: Educating Individuals with Diverse Learning Needs
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 252 (2021 mid-semester quiz and end-of-semester paper): assessment of learners with special needs, classroom climate and learning centres, inclusive education, speech and language disorders, and collaboration.

courses.title: Social Structure of Ghana
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 265 The Social Structure of Ghana (2021): family and kinship, descent systems, households, marriage in Ghana, and inheritance and the Intestate Succession Law (PNDC Law 111).

courses.title: Psychological Basis of Teaching and Learning Mathematics
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 277 (2021 Quiz II): Skemp's theory of relational and instrumental understanding, concepts and schemas, assimilation and accommodation, generalisation, and the director-system model.

courses.title: Network Computing
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 286 Network Computing (August 2021): data communication, protocols, OSI and TCP/IP models, topologies, transmission media and impairments, switching, ISDN and ATM.

courses.title: Educational Psychology
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EPS 101 Educational Psychology (2021/22 quizzes and end-of-semester paper): teaching and instruction, development and home factors, learning theories, memory and forgetting, motivation and classroom management.

courses.title: Literature in English: Poetry
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 149J Literature in English – Poetry (2019/20): types of poetry, ballads, epics, odes, elegies and lyrics, sonnet forms, and an appreciation of Spenser's Amoretti 75.

courses.title: College Algebra
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 102 College Algebra quizzes (2020/21 and 2021/22): quadratics, inequalities, indices, surds and logarithms, sequences and series, matrices and determinants, and linear systems. Every item has a worked explanation.

courses.title: Elementary Geometry
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 145 Elementary Geometry papers (2020/21, April 2021 and 2021/22): coordinate geometry, angles and polygons, mensuration, transformations and constructions, with worked solutions.

courses.title: Calculus
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 301 Calculus quizzes and examinations (2021–2023): limits and continuity, L'Hôpital's rule, differentiation (product, quotient, chain, implicit, parametric), linearisation, rates of change, optimisation and integration.

courses.title: Statistics and Probability I
courses.description: Past questions from University of Cape Coast (Colleges of Education B.Ed / College of Distance Education) EBS 350 Statistics and Probability I (2023 quizzes and examinations): data collection and processing, measures of central tendency and dispersion, frequency distributions and probability.

courses.title: Food and Nutrition
courses.description: WASSCE-style Food and Nutrition practice questions (2022): cooking precautions, vitamin D and calcium, cooking fruits and vegetables, kitchen equipment and planning, canned foods and supermarkets, with model answers.

courses.title: Principles of Cost Accounting
courses.description: WASSCE-style Principles of Cost Accounting practice questions (2022): elements of cost, budgeting, standard costing and variances, process costing, weighted-average stores ledger, marginal costing and contract accounts, with worked solutions.
